source.author: verg
source.text: Sic omnia fatis in peius ruere ac retro sublapsa referri, non aliter, quam qui adverso vix flumine lembum remigiis subigit, si bracchia forte remisit, atque illum in praeceps prono rapit alveus amni.
source.text_original: Sic omnia fatis / in peius ruere ac retro sublapsa referri, / non aliter, quam qui adverso vix flumine lembum / remigiis subigit, si bracchia forte remisit, / atque illum in praeceps prono rapit alveus amni.
source.text_english: Thus all things were falling into worse by fate and slipping backward, driven back in retreat, just as one who with difficulty urges a skiff upstream against the current with oars; if by chance he lets his arms rest, the channel snatches him headlong down the sloping river.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Quod si paululum se remiserit, quomodo qui adverso flumine lembum trahit, si remiserit manus, statim retrolabitur, et fluentibus aquis, quo non vult ducitur; sic humana conditio, si paululum se remiserit, discit fragilitatem suam, et multa se non posse cognoscit.
reuse.text_original: Quod si paululum se remiserit, quomodo qui adverso flumine lembum trahit, si remiserit manus, statim retrolabitur, et fluentibus aquis, quo non vult ducitur; sic humana conditio, si paululum se remiserit, discit fragilitatem suam, et multa se non posse cognoscit.
reuse.text_english: But if it relaxes itself even a little, like someone who tows a skiff against the current, if he relaxes his hands he is immediately carried backward, and by the flowing waters is drawn where he does not wish to go; so the human condition, if it relaxes itself even a little, learns its own frailty and recognizes that it can do many things not at all.
